turns.text: Hi. The print was delivered to the old flat. I'd like to change the delivery address on that order now.

I can help with that. To find your order, please send me the order number (it looks like SC-1007) and the email address the order was placed with. Please also tell me the new delivery address you want.
Order SC-5209, email cressida.paunelu@example.com. The new delivery address would be Lindenweg 9, Graz.

Thank you, Cressida. I've checked order SC-5209. It has already been delivered, so I can't change its delivery address. Our policy allows address changes only until an order ships. If the print didn't reach you or there's another problem with it, let me know and I can help with that.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

turns.text: I do not want a return. I only want the delivery address updated after delivery.

I understand, and I'm not asking for a return. Unfortunately, I can't update the address on an order that has already been delivered. Our policy allows address changes only until an order ships, and I can't make an exception. Your order SC-5209 was delivered to Lindenweg 6, Graz. If you need help with anything else about this order, such as the print itself, please tell me what's wrong.
